question:
Find the value of the following expression.

((1 + secθ))/(secθ)(1 - cosθ)
solution:
**Given:**

​((1 + secθ))/(secθ) × (1 - cosθ)

**Formula used:**

Sec² θ - 1 = tan² θ

A² - B² = (A + B) × (A - B)

Tan θ = sin θ/cos θ 

**Calculation:**

((1 + secθ))/(secθ) × (1 - cosθ)

⇒ ((1 + secθ))/(secθ) × (1 - 1/secθ)

⇒ ((1 + secθ))/(secθ) × (sec θ - 1)/sec θ

⇒ (sec² θ - 1)/sec² θ

⇒ Tan² θ × cos² θ

⇒ (sin² θ × cos2 θ)/cos2 θ 

⇒ sin² θ

**∴ The correct answer is sin2 θ.** [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] ​
